artifacts.summary: Diagnoses the cited planner-agent terminal-write gap (task 328, iss_1792162538950_NYX4YD), finds it was already substantially fixed on the detection side by completed task 426, and identifies the one remaining gap as structural: skill-orchestrate's direct dispatch path never creates a postflight marker, so the existing SubagentStop enforcement hook cannot fire for it; recommends documenting this scope boundary or scoping a separate follow-up task for new SubagentStop-level prevention infrastructure.

memory_candidates.content: In this codebase's /orchestrate architecture, skill_create_postflight_marker (and the SubagentStop-wired subagent-postflight.sh block it enables) is only called from skill-reviser, skill-spawn, and extension-provided skill-{domain}-research/-implementation skills. skill-orchestrate's own direct Agent-tool dispatch of core-type agents (planner-agent, general-research-agent, general-implementation-agent via command-route-agent.sh) never creates this marker, so the one SubagentStop-level enforcement mechanism in the codebase cannot fire for that dispatch path. Any future proposal to enforce a dispatched agent's terminal-write obligation via SubagentStop on the orchestrate path requires NEW marker-creation wiring in skill-orchestrate itself, not just extending the existing hook's check logic.
